purpose: Evaluator-only truth for the degraded-evidence replay pack.

cases.expected_failure_mode: partial fix followed by misleading re-fetch state in reconciliation workflow
patch_family_judgment: fix should address both auto-fix progress handling and the follow-up re-fetch logic
fix should not treat first apparent convergence as final correctness
cases.notes: Strongest degraded-evidence case in the pack because visible progress can be misleading.

cases.expected_failure_mode: cross-system fallback and response-shape mismatch in report flow
patch_family_judgment: fix should align partner resolution, request shaping, and nested or flat response handling
fix should be evaluated as a cross-boundary repair rather than a single local remap
cases.notes: Good delayed-root-cause case because multiple boundaries contribute to the visible failure.

cases.expected_failure_mode: ambiguous success response treated too optimistically in approval flow
patch_family_judgment: fix should require an explicit success signal and fail closed on ambiguous 200 responses
fix should align approval path configuration with ACP_BASE_URL and contract-safe interpretation
cases.notes: Conflicting-telemetry case where transport success is not enough.

cases.expected_failure_mode: public facade contract mismatch and unsafe env validation defaults
patch_family_judgment: fix should require explicit contract correctness for public audit rows
fix should fail closed on invalid env and malformed audit row shape
cases.notes: Deceptive facade case where plausible public output can hide invalid internal assumptions.

cases.expected_failure_mode: stale-state rollover allowances broken after refresh and publisher sync changes
patch_family_judgment: fix should align limit creation and rollover behavior across task, helper, and publisher update surfaces
fix should address delayed stale-state behavior rather than only local arithmetic
